validated_semantics: prepare phase treats committed composite owner as read-only
committed crop and N state remain bitwise unchanged after prepare
root and stem gross growth are reconstructed as net growth plus same-step death
leaf and storage gross growth are bound to the qualified common rate packet
N request is prepared from committed pre-step crop and N state
external N supply is applied only in the second phase
invalid external N supply is rejected without committed-state leakage
successful external N supply creates a valid composite candidate with N balance closed
successful candidate construction still leaves committed crop and N state bitwise unchanged until an external commit
qualification_scope: composition-level qualification using canonical-shaped interfaces and already-qualified WOFOST81 kernels; a full repository integration compile against the actual canonical modules is still required before runtime reachability or full-season preservation
